title: Enforce label scan pin, photo and session ownership
scope: Repair the assigned label scan BOLA in both production analyze-labels routes and upsertScanResults. Reject missing, malformed or mismatched pin/photo/session identifiers before image/provider work; protect persistence against mismatched ownership and foreign conflict rows, atomically. Preserve valid scanning, collaborator access, provider and UI flows. No schema changes.
why: The backend authorization repair needs compiler checks, executable production-route regressions and real PostgreSQL persistence coverage.
coverage: docs/validation/manifest.json test-standard typecheck and unit-tests include server/__tests__/routes.test.ts, where HTTP and isolated PostgreSQL regression cases run.

approval.reference: Assigned task 1012 in the active conversation
approval.direction: Patch cross-session label scan result overwrites without new product flows
approval.applicability: Route and persistence security hardening and regression coverage are within assigned scope; independent verification not selected

assertions.check: Both production routes reject forged foreign, wrong-photo, missing and malformed pin IDs before provider work and leave victim results unchanged.
The production storage method rejects mismatched pin/photo/session relationships and foreign conflict rows without changing any rows in a mixed batch.
Valid same-scope inserts and updates succeed; valid editor access remains accepted.

regression.rationale: Fixes a persistent cross-session data-integrity and object-authorization vulnerability.
regression.covers: R1 client-controlled pin IDs in both endpoints; R2 database insert and conflict update isolation plus atomic batch rollback; R3 authorized scanning compatibility
regression.testLocation: server/__tests__/routes.test.ts — label scan object authorization HTTP and PostgreSQL cases
regression.assertion: Send forged pin IDs through actual production routes and assert rejection and unchanged victim data; call actual storage with invalid ownership and foreign conflicts and assert rejection plus batch rollback; assert normal inserts and updates succeed.
